notes: Deterministic story-director cues. Clinical truth remains in node clinicalTruth + engine state. LLM (Phase 6) may rephrase display flavour only.

cb-quiet-stabilisation.intent: Hold the quiet without declaring the work finished.
cb-quiet-stabilisation.bridge: The bay is quiet enough to plan — not quiet enough to assume the emergency is over.

cb-intermittent-alarm.intent: Treat the alarm as a question, not an automatic code.
cb-intermittent-alarm.bridge: An intermittent alarm opens a clinical question. It does not authorise a ritual response.

cb-resource-allocation.intent: Stage G1 reserve without inventing indication.
cb-resource-allocation.bridge: Resource allocation protects reserve: borrowed circuit as conditional backup, suction endurance assigned once, paid support kept non-medical.

cb-further-alarm.bridge: Further alarm pressure ends the planning window. Protect AAC in place; do not open new questions.

cb-code-blue.intent: Emergency override without doses, energies, or airway replacement.
cb-code-blue.bridge: Override is for circulation work under clinician control. Communication access stays protected; airway replacement stays locked.

cb-provisional-rosc.intent: Name provisional return without ending the story.
cb-provisional-rosc.bridge: A pulse returns and remains provisional. Independent confirmation and reassessment still follow.

cb-post-rosc-reassess.bridge: Post-event reassessment checks circuit, chest movement, and access restore — readiness still is not indication.

cb-aac-restore-family.intent: Restore AAC and keep family/paid support non-clinical.
cb-aac-restore-family.bridge: Access is restored on purpose. Family remain presence and values; paid support stays inside non-medical continuity.

cb-debrief-hook.intent: Close on reflection and authorship, not on a pulse.
cb-debrief-hook.bridge: The slice ends in reflection. Survival was never the victory condition.
